description: This file implements checkpoint writing functionality for machine learning models in a distributed setting, including classes for writing checkpoints, hooks for custom actions, and configuration management.

classes.name: WriterHook
classes.description: Abstract base class for checkpoint commit hooks, providing pre-commit and post-commit callback methods.

classes.name: CheckpointWriter
classes.description: Handles writing state dictionaries to storage with support for distributed barriers and hooks.

classes.name: CheckpointWriterConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for checkpoint writer options, such as barrier timeout.

methods.name: pre_commit
methods.description: Abstract method to perform actions before checkpoint commit.

methods.name: post_commit
methods.description: Abstract method to perform actions after checkpoint commit.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the provided state dictionary to storage, manages hooks and barriers.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the checkpoint writer, releasing resources if needed.
